tools.name: tasks_list
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: The user's tasks in Nightdrive Tasks (kept on this computer, a list per folder): each task's id, title, note, list, due (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM local time), due_label, overdue, priority (high, low or empty) and done. view: open (default: every task not done, soonest due first, those without a due last), today (due today or earlier, overdue included), scheduled (every open task with a due), done (the 50 done most recently), all. Also gives now (the local time, to work out dates from) and the lists with their open counts. Use the ids with tasks_done, tasks_snooze and tasks_trash.

list.title: List
list.description: Only this list's, by its name

query.title: Search
query.description: Words that must all be in the title or the note

tools.name: tasks_add
tools.title: Add a task
tools.description: Adds a task to Nightdrive Tasks. With a due, the user gets a notification at that time (a due date without a time: at 9:00 that day) with Done and Later. list is a list's name; a name that isn't one yet makes a new list (tasks_list gives the lists, so check it before making a near-duplicate); without it, the list Tasks. Returns the task with its id.

due.title: Due
due.description: [DAY] [TIME]: DAY is today, tomorrow, mon … sun (the next one, not today), YYYY-MM-DD or D.M. (5.11.), +3d; TIME is HH:MM (alone: the next such time). Or +30m, +2h. Leave it out for a task without a date

note.title: Note
note.description: More about it, as plain text

tools.name: tasks_done
tools.title: Mark a task done
tools.description: Marks a task in Nightdrive Tasks done (it moves to the done view). id is a task's id from tasks_list.

tools.name: tasks_snooze
tools.title: Move a task's due
tools.description: Gives a task in Nightdrive Tasks a new due time, as the notification's Later does: without until, an hour from now (a task due on a day without a time: tomorrow). With until, that time (also to set a due on a task that has none, or to bring one earlier). It is notified again at the new time.

until.title: Until
until.description: [DAY] [TIME]: DAY is today, tomorrow, mon … sun (the next one, not today), YYYY-MM-DD or D.M. (5.11.), +3d; TIME is HH:MM (alone: the next such time). Or +30m, +2h

tools.name: tasks_trash
tools.title: Move a task to the trash
tools.description: Takes a task out of Nightdrive Tasks (it is kept for 30 days, and the user can undo it from the notification). For a task that is finished, use tasks_done instead.
tools.notice: Moved the task {title} to the trash
